games.name: Chroma Zero
games.imagesHtml: 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗
games.longDescription:
Explore a unique and connected world. Understand its fragile balance, uncover its deepest questions, and find more than just the answers.

Chroma Zero immerses you in a universe of mystery, color, energy, and movement, and challenges your expectations and intuition. There are no levels, the puzzles are integrated into the fabric of the space itself, and everything can change in the blink of an eye. Exploration and curiosity are rewarded.

Key Features:

Knowledge Based Progression - Learn the rules of the space, and you can progress farther in the world and deeper into the mystery
Open-world Puzzles - Explore everywhere, the world itself is the puzzle. There are no levels.
Extremely Dynamic Environment - The world reacts to your actions in dramatic fashion
An enchanting and beautiful Original Score by Adam Kromelow and Dan Rufolo
Narrative with charm and wit, and at times, wit and charm

Gameplay:

Players typically spend 6-12 hours to finish the game, and a bit more to explore everything. Most progress is gated only by knowledge, which is gained by exploring and experimenting.

This is an immersive, non-linear, risk-taking and moderately challenging game, made by a solo developer (hi there). The narrative is mostly light-hearted, but can be impactful at times. The puzzles ramp up in difficulty, though the game helps to guide you as well. So if you're exploring everywhere, you will know what to do -- maybe just not how to do it! I was inspired by games like Antichamber, Outer Wilds, Myst/Riven, and the discovery elements of Tunic. I hope to bring more games like these into the world, since by their nature they are focused on giving you a wonderful and surprising first-playthrough.

One of 2022’s most acclaimed indies, the Game Awards-nominated Citizen Sleeper comes to PlayStation®!

You are a sleeper, a digitised human consciousness in an artificial body, owned by a corporation that wants you back. Thrust amongst the unfamiliar and colourful inhabitants of the Eye, you need to build friendships, earn your keep, and navigate the factions of this strange metropolis, if you hope to survive to see the next cycle.

COMPLETE. EXPANDED.
The PlayStation® version of Citizen Sleeper includes the complete post-launch three episode sequence, which expands the lore of the game, and introduces additional characters and locations to Erlin’s Eye in an exciting late game storyline.

ROLL THE DICE. DO THE WORK. GET PAID. SURVIVE.
Inspired by Tabletop Roleplaying games, Citizen Sleeper uses Dice, Clocks and Drives to create a player-led experience, where you choose your path in a rich and responsive world. Each cycle you use the dice you are dealt to choose what to do with your time. Make or break alliances, uncover truths and escape your hunters. Survive and ultimately thrive, one cycle at a time, and sometimes against the clock!

TURN UP FOR YOUR FRIENDS
The station plays host to characters from all walks of life, trying to eke out an existence among the stars. Salvagers, engineers, hackers, bartenders, street-food vendors, each has a history which brought them here. You choose which of them you wish to help, and together you will shape your future.

ACCESS THEIR SECRETS
Eventually, you will learn to use your dice to hack into the station’s cloud to access decades of digital data, uncover new areas and unlock secrets. This is your unique power, and with it you can change your future. Corporate secrets, rogue AIs and troves of lost data await those willing to dive into the depths of the station’s networks.

YOU WERE MADE TO DIE
Essen-Arp: to them you are just property, one more asset in a portfolio that stretches across the stars. You are the product of an abusive system, in a universe where humanity’s expansion is marked by exploitation and extraction. Escape the makers of your decaying body, and chart your own path in a richly imagined, deeply relevant sci-fi world which explores ideas of precarity, personhood and freedom.

games.shortDescription: A DICE-DRIVEN RPG
games.longDescription:
The highly anticipated sequel to one of 2022’s most acclaimed RPGs!

You are a sleeper, an emulation of a human mind housed in an artificial body. You are on the run from the corporation that made you and the gang that seeks to control you. Commandeer a ship, build a network of crew and allies, and take on challenging contracts as you seek to build a future for yourself.

Choose a class, configure your skills and assemble your crew in unique tabletop-inspired gameplay. Your future depends on the roll of a dice, as you make difficult choices in a complex world. Reinventing the award-winning systems of Citizen Sleeper, this RPG will satisfy both fans of the original game and new players alike.

STAY AHEAD OF YOUR PAST
After a desperate attempt to free yourself from servitude by rewriting the very code that governs your system, you are on the run again, this time with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past.

REBOOT / REBUILD / REPAIR
Citizen Sleeper’s revolutionary dice system returns, revised for the sequel. Manage your stress or take damage to your dice. Deal with glitches as they accrue in your system. Push yourself to get lucky and make this cycle count.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Each character class now has a unique “Push” ability that can help you turn the tide of a difficult job or send you into a dangerous spiral depending on how and when you choose to use it. Reroll your dice to change your fate, or focus a single die to bet everything on a big success.

NAVIGATE THE BELT
Chart a course from hub to hub with complete freedom, taking on jobs and setting goals as you see fit. A living world, the Starward Belt rewards curiosity and care, but it's up to you to decide which locations and stories deserve your time and resources.

DO THE JOB, GET PAID
Contracts offer a new kind of focussed, tactical gameplay to the Citizen Sleeper experience. You’ll need to prepare carefully and choose the right approach for these multi-cycle, high-risk, high-reward jobs, but you’ll also have to react and adapt to both the roll of the dice and the twists and turns of each task.

CHOOSE YOUR FUTURE
Player choice is a massive part of the Citizen Sleeper experience, and the sequel deepens this with new skill checks that allow you to express your class and character in scenes, as well as branching storylines that will ask you to make hard choices. The future of your character is up to you.

games.longDescription:
Prepare yourself for the ultimate adrenaline rush with CLAWPUNK, a pulse-pounding, melee-focused 2D action game infused with roguelite elements and an array of badass cat characters. Tear through a fully destructible environment, where every smash and bash rewards your reactive and aggressive play style. SEMI-NON-LINEAR PROGRESSION: Battle through five level zones, with the freedom to tackle the first four in any order, all starting from a central hub level.

CHARACTER MANAGEMENT: Master nine unique cat characters, each with their own weapons and stats, to tailor your play style.

COLLECTABLE CARDS: Discover and collect special cards throughout your journey, permanently saving them to mutate and enhance your cats' abilities.

AGGRESSIVE GAMEPLAY: Dive into non-stop, push-forward combat that rewards daring players with powerful rage attacks for diving headfirst into the fray.

DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENT: Explore and defeat enemies creatively, or simply indulge in the sheer joy of destroying everything in sight!

CHALLENGING, YET ACCESSIBLE DIFFICULTY: Enjoy a scalable difficulty system that caters to both rookies and seasoned players seeking a formidable challenge.

80/90s RETRO THEME: Immerse yourself in a 1980/90s cyberpunk-inspired world, complete with a hard metal soundtrack, along with a pinch of synth, and gritty industrial/ambient soundscapes.

games.longDescription:
"Step into the next generation of urban public transport with City Transport Simulator 2026!
Experience the most immersive bus and tram simulation yet, with a dynamic city that reacts to your every decision. Manage your fleet, plan routes, and explore a richly detailed European-inspired metropolis like never before.

City Transport Simulator 2026 is FREE for all previous CTS owners!
Transfer your DLCs at no cost and enjoy them upgraded with all the new features, including dynamic weather, free roam mode, realistic ticketing, and much more.

Take control of six fully licensed vehicles, each faithfully recreated with authentic details and driving dynamics:

Buses
- Solobus: MAN Lion’s City A21 (2 or 3 doors)
- Solobus: Gräf/Steyr NL205
- Articulated Bus: MAN Lion's City A23 (3 or 4 doors)
- Articulated Bus: Gräf/Steyr NG235

Trams
- Vienna ULF A1
- Vienna ULF B1
- Munich R2.2b

Dynamic Weather & Seasons
City Transport Simulator 2026 introduces fully dynamic weather and seasonal changes, creating a living, evolving city environment:

- Seasonal city transformation – trees, foliage, and cityscape adapt to spring, summer, autumn, and winter
- Sunny, fog, rain, snow, or thunderstorms – dynamically changing throughout the day
- Temperature changes affect vehicle heating and cooling systems
- All vehicles, buses and trams, feature realistic heating, cooling, and window operations
- Fully operational wipers respond to rain and adverse weather conditions


Realistic Ticketing System
Every bus now includes a fully functional ticket machine:

- Sell tickets to passengers directly
- Accept both cash and contactless payments
- Integrated pay table ensures correct change is given
- Adds an extra layer of realism to your public transport management


Free Roam & Passenger Experience
Explore the city like never before in the new free roam mode:

- Walk as a pedestrian and board AI buses and trams as a passenger
- Take control of vehicles at any time and switch dynamically between passenger, bus driver, and tram driver
- Hand over vehicles at endpoints without breaking immersion


Lighting & Visual Enhancements
The new dynamic lighting system brings the city to life:

- Realistic day/night cycle with atmospheric lighting
- Enhanced interior and exterior lighting for all vehicles
- Updated shadows, reflections, and ambient effects for maximum realism


Drive Like a Pro
Every vehicle features:

- Precise real-world physics
- Authentic engine and ambient sounds
- Interactive cockpits with fully simulated controls
- Keyboard, gamepad, joystick, and steering wheel support with preconfigured profiles for popular wheels
- Custom control mapping to play your way


Build & Manage Your Network
Plan and optimize your public transport empire:

- Line Editor and Timetable Generator to create custom tram and bus lines in just a few clicks
- Assign vehicles and let AI trams and buses follow your schedule in real time
- Monitor and optimize operations as your network grows alongside the city’s needs


Career or Sandbox – Play Your Way

Career Mode
Start small and grow your operation: transport passengers, maintain timetables, earn XP, unlock new vehicles and upgrades, and increase passenger satisfaction. Expand your network across the city and become a transport tycoon.

Sandbox Mode
No restrictions, full freedom: explore the city, drive any vehicle, and manage lines as you like. Play with up to 15 pre-made tram and bus lines or create your own.

Introducing Climate Station
This isn’t just an app—it’s a portal into the living history of our planet and the futures we still have time to shape.

This app has been designed for multiple functions; experience it from the comfort of your own home, or broaden horizons in research and educational settings. Or you can even put it to work as an interactive, scientific tool, transforming complex data into immersive experiences to inspire action—for yourself and others.

Coffee Talk Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

In a city of paper and steel, as large as a country, a small café gives humans and fantasy people a cosy place to be. Brew the right order for your customers as they seek refuge from the sweltering Tokyo summer heat and share heartfelt stories to chill lo-fi beats.

Set in Tokyo, a city where old and new coexist, this newest game in the Coffee Talk franchise brings back familiar elements with new twists.

New Cafe, New Customers

Kenji, the traditional kappa salaryman, striving to find meaning and a way forward after retirement.
Vin, the Barista's assistant coping with a fractured past and the daily consequences of a previous disaster.
Ayame, a happy-go-lucky but recently deceased It girl, struggling to make sense of her new (after)life.

Lo-fi Beats Soundtrack by Andrew "AJ" Jeremy
The composer for Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2, AJ, returns once again with new tracks to set the lo-fi soundscape and chill atmosphere.

Say it with Stencils
Elevate your latte art with sprinkle stencils. Easily create beautiful latte art by sprinkling a powdery design on a customer's drink, then make it your own by adding milk and etching.

Master of Tomodachill
Engage with your customers on the social network Tomodachill. Learn more about their stories and help them discover the truth they're seeking or make life-changing connections.

games.imagesHtml: 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗
games.shortDescription: Master the Spectrum: A Minimalist Challenge of Pure Color and Memory
games.longDescription:
The Essence of Pure Color Colorium is a minimalist experience stripped of all distractions. No lighting effects, no complex textures, and no shadows—just the raw power of color. It is designed for those who believe they have a "perfect eye" for the spectrum. Here, your only tools are your retinas and your focus. In a world filled with visual noise, Colorium challenges you to see the truth. Can you identify the finest shift in hue? Can you remember a color that has vanished?

Five Modes of Absolute Perception Colorium features five distinct game modes:
Memory Mode: Recall exact color placements in a hidden grid.
Find Odd: Spot the subtle outlier in a field of identical colors.
Find Different: Identify the microscopic shift in pigment between two tones.
Find Which Color is Changed: Track a single tile as it subtly transforms in real-time.
The Vanished Hue: Identify exactly which shade has been removed from the screen.

A Natural Diagnostic for Color Vision Colorium is a powerful tool for uncovering color vision deficiencies. As you progress through the game, subtle patterns in your performance can reveal conditions such as red-green color blindness, blue-yellow deficiency, or other forms of color perception impairment—challenges that many people live with without ever knowing. Colorium does not replace a clinical diagnosis, but it creates a uniquely honest mirror for your visual biology. If certain spectrums consistently challenge you, the game will make it visible.

Train Your Mind While You Play Beyond color, Colorium is a genuine workout for your cognitive abilities. Each session actively engages working memory as you retain and compare color sequences under pressure. The game sharpens selective attention, training your brain to filter out irrelevant visual information and lock onto meaningful differences. Over time, players report measurable improvements in focus, perceptual speed, and the ability to detect fine detail—skills that extend far beyond the game itself.

Zen Through Focus
Pure Minimalism: No light or shadows. Just flat color logic.
Calm and Focused: No leaderboards or pressure. A pure Zen experience.
Visual Calibration: Improve your "eye for detail" and chromatic sensitivity.
Atmospheric Clarity: Low-profile ambient soundtrack for a perfect flow state.

Enter the spectrum. Challenge your perception. Discover the true depth of color.

games.shortDescription: The greatest Adventure of all time!
games.longDescription:
A massive, magical escape room. Retro-inspired, point-&-click, mystical cave exploration. Auto-magic maps, limited inventory, fantastic creatures and a deep mystery at the heart of the experience. From award winning designer of King’s Quest and Phantasmagoria.

Colossal Cave is a classic, cozy 3D Adventure; slow down, explore a massive magical, labyrinthine cave system, all while solving clever, sprawling puzzles at your own pace. Auto-magic maps, limited inventory, all the fantastic creatures and a deep mystery at the heart of the experience.

You may hear its heart beating while approaching the volcano.

COZY CAVE ADVENTURE

First-person POV with classic point-&-click controls: walk, look, interact, pick things up, and test your theories. Limited inventory requires clever management in its own right. A magical series of maps quietly track where you’ve been, marking where you’ve dropped items.

Simply focus on solving puzzles instead of wrestling with navigation.

CHILL VIBES, CLEVER MYSTERY

This is not a frantic action game; no frenetic timers shouting at you, no combo meters to maintain—just you, your lamp, and a series of intertwined, sprawling, twisty corridors full of brainy, logic-driven challenges.

Take your time:

- Try weird solutions. Trial and error can be your friend.
- Double back to old rooms with new ideas and unlock potential new discoveries.
- Follow that “what if I…?” inclination and see what the cave passes back.

CREATURES, TREASURE, & STRANGE MAGIC

The cave is quiet, but not without your footsteps.

You’ll bump into:

- Mischievous dwarves with sharp daggers and sharper tempers.
- A grumpy, red bridge guarding troll.
- A noticeably absent giant. You see that?
- Flickering hinkypunks and other odd cave-dwellers. A handsome pirate, perhaps?
- Hidden treasures, strange artifacts, and places that feel just a little too magical to be natural.

Some encounters are charming, whilst others are just dangerous enough to keep you on your toes—but it all stays firmly in “casual mystical adventure,” not horror. Just fantasy with a slice of mystery.

That said, all good Adventures suggest one should save early, save often.

RETRO-COOL, PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Colossal Cave 3D leans into that old-school adventure game atmosphere: colorful environments, shadowy silhouettes, bats, and a focus on exploring the world for clues rather than being led by the nose.

No lack of customization allows dialing the game to match your vibe with a variety of options, including comfort tweaks and settings. Snap turns, or nuke the narrator. It's all there. Play exactly how you like—curled up with a controller, a mouse, a headset, or a keyboard, slowly dawdling through the cave one cavern at a time.

FEATURES

- Relaxed, point-&-click exploration in a massive cave
- Limited inventory that makes item choices and puzzle routes matter
- Handy auto-map that shows where you’ve been and where you dropped items
- A cast of dwarves, elves, hinkypunks, and other quirky cave creatures
- Dozens of logic-driven puzzles with satisfying “aha!” moments
- Retro-cool adventure vibes inspired by classic games
- Flexible customization options so you can make the adventure as meditative and away as you want
- The mythic, mellow cavecation!
